The same patients were studied at PEEP 5 cmH2O (fixed PEEP) and at Express PEEP (Pplat 28-30, 'other') before the two tested strategies; both conditions are kept as arms with data, so both comparator types apply.
Express (PEEP to reach Pplat 28-30 cmH2O) is a comparator strategy applied in the same patients with no dedicated enum value.
rulings.evidence: p. 2, Study protocol - Settings; pp. 5-6 Table 1

rulings.reason: DeepSeek's signal_quality_verification_only is wrong: a filling calibration is reported (balloon inflated to 2, 3 and 4 mL, volume giving maximal tidal Pes retained) plus a modified Baydur occlusion test with 0.8-1.2 acceptance. GLM's 'other' is defensible, but choosing the filling volume with the largest tidal Pes swing is arguably best_compliance_or_pressure_volume_filling. Co-author: choose between 'other' and best_compliance_or_pressure_volume_filling.
rulings.evidence: p. 2, Study protocol - Settings; p. 3 first line; CODEBOOK Calibration

rulings.reason: Table 1 reports time from ARDS diagnosis to inclusion 39 (27-51) h, which matches reference_event ards_onset (both reviewers); the tested strategies followed inclusion after the 45-min PEEP 5 and Express steps.

Median 39 h from ARDS diagnosis, IQR 27-51 h, enrolment allowed up to 72 h: the upper quartile lies beyond the 48-h cut. The codebook gives a median rule for obesity but none for timing, so early_within_48h (median) and mixed (distribution) are both defensible. Co-author: decide the aggregation rule and apply it consistently across studies.
rulings.evidence: p. 2, Study patients; p. 5, Table 1; CODEBOOK Subgroup flags
